heading: Evaluation context
text:
### Evaluation context [IRET.9.2]

Everything an expression evaluation may read, gathered into one value so
evaluation itself is a pure function of its context:

| Field | Holds |
|---|---|
| token | the current partial match — how a slot reference resolves |
| right_fact | the fact arriving on the right, during join evaluation |
| bind_frame | the `let` bindings in scope |
| bind_count | how many are bound |
| engine | reached only for builtin dispatch and the clock |

Two properties are load-bearing:

**`right_fact` is absent when evaluating a RHS action.** That is what
distinguishes the two evaluation sites — a join test evaluates against a
candidate fact, an action evaluates after the match is settled and there
is no candidate. Its absence is the signal, not an error.

**The bind frame is stack-allocated.** `let` bindings live for exactly
one evaluation, so they cost no allocation and need no freeing — which is
what lets `let` be used freely under `constspace` and in LIVE mode.
